parameter_policy: Fixed from original-paper prescriptions before new performance runs; no performance-driven choice or tuning; all three BL parameterizations are retained, never select best post hoc.
interpretation: Retrospective descriptive screening on an already inspected test suite, not a new independent confirmatory holdout.

method_contracts.IMED: Honda and Takemura 2015 Algorithm1; empirical Dinf on [0,1]; initially pull each arrived arm once. Exact one/two-observed-support implementation for this suite, no true support input.
method_contracts.Bayes-UCB: Kaufmann et al. 2012 Algorithm1, independent uniform Beta(1,1), c=0, quantile 1-1/t. No forced initialization. Fractional-count heuristic on the non-Bernoulli scenario, same convention as existing TS; no valid Bernoulli posterior claim there.
method_contracts.KL-UCB+: Bernoulli KL, n*kl(mean,q)<=log(t/n), c=0, 32 bisection steps, initialize arrived arms once. Bounded-reward mean-based adaptation.
method_contracts.empirical-KL-UCB: Cappe et al. 2013 empirical-distribution upper confidence index; n*Dinf(Fhat,q)<=log(t), c=0 empirical choice discussed by Honda2015. Initialize arrived arms once; exact observed two-support computation.
method_contracts.UCB-V: Audibert et al. 2009 Eq18 with variance divisor n, zeta=1,c=1,b=1, their experimental prescription; not a claim that zeta>1 theorem applies.
method_contracts.UCB1-Tuned: Auer et al. 2002 variance-adaptive heuristic, variance divisor n, standard min(1/4,V+sqrt(2logt/n)) factor.
method_contracts.AUER: Kleinberg et al. 2008 Algorithm2, mean+sqrt(8logt/n). Same family as existing UCB1 but original published exploration constant; preserve all history.
method_contracts.SB-EXP3-ATGT: Nguyen and Mehta 2024 Algorithm5, gamma=0, two-level doubling, exact sleeping regret update. No final K or T. Its published per-action sleeping comparator differs from this study current-best dynamic comparator.
method_contracts.BL-MOSS: Ghalme et al. 2021 Algorithm1/prose adaptation to batches: accept first ceil(T^(1/(1+2beta))) arriving labels, run current-accepted-K MOSS with known T, retain old data. beta=.5,1,2 are assumed sensitivity values, not fitted true arrival-tail parameters. Original one-new-arm-per-round/theoretical tail assumptions are not asserted.

primary_summary: Report per-scenario mean and MCSE plus paired difference baseline minus F-R, two-sided 95% t intervals and Bonferroni across 16 comparators by 12 scenarios. Equal-scenario averages descriptive, with large-tail summaries and no winner filtering.
frozen_material_protection: Current manuscript and original numerical source/results must remain byte unchanged.
